q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: WITH new_table AS (SELECT f.bar, s.price, s.beer FROM frequents AS f JOIN serves AS s ON s.bar = f.bar WHERE drinker LIKE '%B%'), average_price AS (SELECT beer, AVG(price) AS ap, (MAX(price) - MIN(price)) AS gap FROM serves GROUP BY beer) SELECT a_p.beer, a_p.gap, a_p.ap FROM average_price AS a_p JOIN new_table AS nt ON a_p.beer = nt.beer GROUP BY a_p.beer, a_p.ap, a_p.gap HAVING COUNT(nt.bar) > 1
